SELECT SUM(s.Enrollment (K-12)) AS TotalSATTestTakers
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.FRPM Count (K-12) IN (
    SELECT MAX(FRPM Count (K-12))
    FROM frpm
)

SELECT SUM(s.Enrollment (K-12)) AS TotalSATTestTakers
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.FRPM Count (K-12) IN (
    SELECT MAX(FRPM Count (K-12))
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.FRPM Count (K-12) = (SELECT MAX(FRPM Count (K-12)) FROM frpm);

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = SUBSTR(s.cds, 4, 10)
WHERE f.FRPM Count (K-12) = (SELECT MAX(FRPM Count (K-12)) FROM frpm);

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = SUBSTR(s.cds, 5)
WHERE f.FRPM Count (K-12) = (SELECT MAX(FRPM Count (K-12)) FROM frpm);

SELECT SUM(satscores.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.sname = schools.School
WHERE schools.GSoffered = 'K-12'
ORDER BY frpm['FRPM Count (K-12)'] DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(satscores.NumTstTakr)
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm.FRPM Count (K-12) IN (
    SELECT MAX(FRPM Count (K-12))
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM frpm f

    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`)

FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
